exclusions.reason: AI_Rerank excluded from judge validation (operator decision, issue #35, 2026-08-02). Of its 49 files, only 18 share a filename with the AI condition and are suffix-swap recoverable; the other 31 draw from a larger generated pool than the AI condition's 49 sampled ideas and their idea_id cannot be recovered from the released id_title_mapping.csv at all. Including only the recoverable 18 would represent the condition by a non-random 37% subsample. Validation needs a reliable expert-scored set, not a complete one — Human + AI (98 ideas) is sufficient.
